notes_for_editor: Single source: one row in the tnlandforms list, with no survey number (the column reads gw topo). The list says a few entries came from 1:100,000 USGS topo maps; this is not confirmed for Inverness. The Eastern US Lookouts North Carolina page has no Inverness entry (its Hoke County entries are Raeford and Sanatorium), and two web searches found nothing about an Inverness tower. The story is under 120 words because no other evidence was found. Worth a check against the NC Forest Service Hoke County office or an FFLA list before anyone expands it.
